meta.name: intelligence-collection-disciplines
meta.description: Run competitive research like an intelligence agency: eight collection disciplines (OSINT to MASINT), signal-to-inference chains, and fusion. Use when one-source research isn't enough.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用情报学科方法做竞品研究
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果单一来源的研究不足以支撑你的竞争分析。
copy.tagline_en: Run competitive research using intelligence disciplines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if single-source research isn't enough for your competitive analysis.

howto.what: 把竞争调研变成八条独立情报线(OSINT 到 MASINT),每条给出免费/付费来源、信号到推断链条、以及它支撑的 PM 工件;最后做全源融合,把多个独立弱信号叠加成强结论。
howto.when: 当你提出的竞争或市场问题不是单一来源能回答时触发;原文要求先有要改变的决策,否则会停下追问。典型是怀疑对手有动作、想在发布前确认。

say.text: 帮我用八种情报学科调查 Meridian Freight 进军仓储机器人的传闻。
say.note: 会按八个学科逐项收集信号并交叉验证。

say.text: 查一下这家对手最近的专利和招聘,判断他们是不是在做平台化。
say.note: 对应 TECHINT 和 HUMINT 渠道。

say.text: 用信号到推断链条分析这个市场,我要用来更新路线图。
say.note: 会先确认 DECISION 再开始。

howto.what_en: Organize competitive research into eight collection disciplines (OSINT through MASINT), each with free/paid sources, signal-to-inference chains, and the PM artifacts they feed; then fuse findings by stacking confidence across independent signals.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a competitive or market question needs more than one source. If no decision to inform is given, it stops and asks for one.

say_en.text: Look at this competitor's patents and hiring to see if they're building a platform.
say_en.note: Maps to TECHINT and HUMINT channels.

say_en.text: Run signal-to-inference chains on this market; I need it for roadmap updates.
